title: Men as a share of employed US registered nurses, 1970–2025
description: Bar chart of the percentage of employed registered nurses in the United States who were men. 1970: 2.7 per cent. 1980: 4.1. 1990: 5.7. 2000: 7.6. 2006: 8.9. 2011: 9.6 (US Census Bureau, from the census and the American Community Survey). 2025: 12.7 (Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey annual averages, 87.3 per cent women; a different survey, so not strictly comparable).
heading: MEN AS % OF EMPLOYED US REGISTERED NURSES
